business_summary: Diversified financial services group: Motilal Oswal AMC (largest profit pool), capital markets (broking, institutional equities, investment banking), private wealth (Motilal Oswal Wealth, family office), and balance-sheet-led housing finance and asset-backed lending. Q2 FY27: operating PAT Rs718cr (+29% YoY) per company-derived summaries; headline PAT ~Rs1,081cr including treasury gains (Moneycontrol). Screener Sep-26 quarter: sales Rs1,748cr, OPM 57%, net profit Rs566cr. Stock Rs1,091 (+25% in 3m, near 52-week high Rs1,092), P/E 46, mcap Rs65,803cr. Leadership rejig announced 2026-11-03.

exposures.mechanism: +20% traded value/demat additions: broking and distribution (cash segment, ~30% of revenue) + IB/ECM fees + MO AMC flows: revenue +5%, with fixed costs EBITDA +8% in 4 quarters x EV/MCap 1.3 (net debt ~Rs 20k cr funding NBFC/HFC book, model) x persistence 0.6 => ~+7. Screener: Sep-26 OPM 57%, Jun-26 59%, vs 19% in Mar-26 (volatile treasury).

evidence.note: Motilal Oswal Q2 FY27: operating PAT Rs718cr (+29% YoY), asset management now largest profit pool (TaxGuru/Investywise via search); headline PAT 'surges 3-fold to Rs1,081cr' (Moneycontrol headline 2026-10-29, includes investment gains; Univest figure unverified)

exposures.mechanism: +10% SIP/DII flows -> mutual fund AUM +1.5% pa and higher AMC fees (asset management is the largest profit pool): AUM +1.5% => AMC revenue +1.5% x ~45% of PAT => +0.7% PAT; plus wealth/PMS inflows => +2.5 after multiple.

evidence.note: Motilal Oswal Q2 FY27: operating PAT Rs718cr (+29% YoY), asset management now largest profit pool (TaxGuru/Investywise via search); headline PAT 'surges 3-fold to Rs1,081cr' (Moneycontrol headline 2026-10-29, includes investment gains; Univest figure unverified)

exposures.mechanism: +$5bn/qtr FPI inflow: Nifty +3-4% x market beta 1.64-1.84 (pack) => +6; cash volumes and treasury MTM both rise.
+5 VIX points: Nifty -1.5 to -2% x beta ~1.7 => -3; plus lower volumes and treasury MTM; pack +0.35 per SSU (t 0.8) is a wrong-sign weak estimate (market-adjusted) => -3.5 overall.

+1 = higher LTCG/STT/F&O tax: volumes -8% and AUM flows -3% => EBITDA -10% x persistence 0.7 x EV/MCap 1.3 => -9 on a 'hike'; probability-weighted sign is skewed up since FM says open to reviewing (2026-10-13/11-03: shares +7% intraday) => symmetrical weight for a tightening step -4.5 (a cut would be roughly +5).

evidence.note: Nifty Capital Markets +2%; Motilal Oswal, Angel One up to 7% as FM Sitharaman says open to reviewing equity tax (Moneycontrol/Business Standard headlines, 2026-11-03); same remarks reported 2026-10-13 by Kotak Neo/UNI: willing to hear views, no formal review

exposures.mechanism: +1 tightening step on F&O (lot sizes, weekly expiry curbs, margin): MO's F&O share of broking revenue is low (cash/institutional heavy, ~15% of broking), broking ~25% of revenue => revenue -1% => EBITDA -2% x 1.3 x 0.7 => ~-2; far smaller than for BSE/Angel One.
+1 structural savings shift into equities/MF/PMS: AUM CAGR +3pp, wealth assets +3pp => revenue +4%, EBITDA +6% x 1.3 x 1.0 => ~+5.

+25bp repo: borrowings ~Rs 20k cr (model; NCD programme Rs3,000cr approved Q2 per Multibagg headline) mostly floating bank lines: +Rs50cr pre-tax cost vs TTM PAT Rs1,427cr (screener) => -2.6% x persistence 0.5 x EV/MCap 1.3... NIM partly passed through => -1.0.

evidence.note: RBI MPC hiked repo 25bp to 5.50%, stance 'calibrated tightening' (Hindu/Reuters/CNBC TV18 headlines)

exposures.mechanism: +50bp spreads on NCD/bank funding (balance-sheet NBFC/HFC book): cost +Rs50-60cr => PAT -3% x 0.5 => -1.5.
+1pp GDP -> corporate profit +2% -> IB/ECM and wealth flows; EBITDA +3% x 1.3 x 0.6 => +2.
+3% USD/INR (weaker): pack -7.96 (t -1.5) reflects FPI outflow channel (high beta 1.43); shrunk by ~80% => -1.5. No direct FX balance sheet exposure of note.
+5% S&P 500: pack +3.10 per SSU (t +1.1), risk-on spillover into FPI flows; shrunk to +1.5.
